_comment: Manual category overrides applied at the bridge boundary so we never have to edit the upstream-generated ModuleAdd.h. Mostly: assigning real categories to effects that arrive labelled 'Unclassified'. Family rule: an effect named X3 inherits X2's category; an effect named ConsoleY{Buss,Channel,Pre} goes under 'Consoles'. Review pass 2026-06-11: BitDualPan->Stereo confirmed via blog post (2026-05-31); CStrip corrected Effects->Filter (upstream puts CStrip2 and EQ under Filter); PearLiteEQ->Filter confirmed via family rule (Pear/Pear2/PearEQ all Filter); PurestConsole4* confirmed via family rule; WoodenBox override REMOVED (upstream now categorizes it 'Tone Color' itself). Still best-guess, no blog post yet as of 2026-06-11: PunchyDeluxe, PunchyGuitar (Dynamics from the name), X2Buss (Consoles; site search maps it to the ConsoleX2 family), kRockstar (Reverb; every k-series effect upstream is Reverb), and Longhand ('Effects' is a pure placeholder - only Input/Output/Dry-Wet, no docs). Reclassify those once Chris posts about them.
